L30@P0-1: billion for the trailing twelve months ended June 30, 2022.“It was another strong quarter of progress for Amazon,” said Andy Jassy, Amazon CEO. “We continued lowering our cost to

L39@P1: Highlights
L40@P1: Obsessing over the customer experience
L41@P1: Amazon obsesses over how to make customers’ lives better and easier every day. This is true for consumers, sellers, brands,
L42@P1: developers, enterprises, and creators. For example, Amazon:
L43@P1: • Delivered its largest selection of products to U.S. Prime members at the fastest speeds ever in the quarter. The
L44@P1: company now offers U.S. Prime members free Same-Day or One-Day Delivery on tens of millions of the most popular
L45@P1: items. Across the top 60 largest U.S. metro areas, more than half of Prime member orders arrived the same or next day
L46@P1: in the quarter. So far this year, Amazon has delivered more than 1.8 billion units to U.S. Prime members the same or
L47@P1: next day—nearly four times the number of units delivered at those speeds by this point in 2019.
L48@P1: • Held the biggest Prime Day event ever on July 11-12, in the third quarter, as Prime members worldwide purchased
L49@P1: more than 375 million items and saved more than $2.5 billion. This year, Amazon offered more deals than any past
L50@P1: Prime Day, with Home, Fashion, and Beauty among the top-selling deal categories. This was the largest Prime Day
L51@P1: ever for Amazon’s independent sellers, most of which are small and medium-sized businesses, and the first where
L52@P1: U.S.-based Prime members could shop deals directly from merchant sites using Buy with Prime.
L53@P1: • Increased selection in the U.S. Amazon store. Amazon added new beauty and fashion brands, including D’Amelio
L54@P1: Footwear, Dyson hair care, IT Cosmetics, Ralph Lauren Fragrances, and Urban Decay, and extended its collaboration
L55@P1: with Victoria’s Secret. This marks the first time Victoria’s Secret lingerie and apparel are available through a retail
L56@P1: partner in North America. Amazon also expanded its selection of grocery items from brands such as General Mills and
L57@P1: Coca-Cola.

L59@P1: and serving more than 6 million customers. Amazon Business allows businesses, municipalities, and organizations to
L60@P1: procure products like office supplies and other bulk items easily and at discounted prices.

L67@P1: for customers’ personal schedules, this free Prime benefit uses 30% fewer boxes on average.

L71@P1: announced a Small Business Search filter, which helps customers easily discover and shop for products from small
